name: Insufficient Visual Distinction of Homoglyphs Presented to User

vulnerable.description: Identifier pair visually identical via Cyrillic 'а' (U+0430); auth check reads the impostor
Zero-width space (U+200B) inside a group literal used in an equality auth check
Real Hangul filler (U+3164) after a comma in a command array: a third element no reviewer can see (secure-coding/no-invisible-characters)

safe.description: Plain ASCII identifiers with a single canonical role constant
Legitimate Hebrew/Russian/Japanese translation strings in UI copy (FP lock)
The filler written as a visible \u3164 escape plus ordinary Korean syllables and jamo (FP lock against a range-based check)
